page.overview:
What is Poor Twisted Me?

Poor Twisted Me is the ninth song from 1996's album Load. It was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich, and have a length of 4:02.

The subject matter is about reveling in self-pity, thriving on misery, feeding off sympathy like "feast[ing] on sympathy" and "chew[ing] on agony," preferring the comfort of woe to facing reality, a tongue-in-cheek jab at "drama queens" or self-absorbed musicians.

Oh, poor twisted me Oh, poor twisted me I feast on sympathy I chew on suffer I chew on agony

Swallow whole the pain Oh, it's too good to be That all this misery Is just for, oh, poor twisted me Poor twisted me
